title: Normalize Cursor-native skill frontmatter and scoped paths

Do not rewrite descriptions, do not relocate _archived/, and do not scope empty or secrets-correlated skills.

stress_test.blast_radius: Wrong nest loses governance metadata or breaks deprecated-skill detection. Wrong paths hide a skill exactly when it is needed. A checker that cannot parse folded YAML false-fails l9-bounded-autonomy and blocks make pr.
